Name: (CP) Seasonal Vanilla UI
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img]﻿
[font=Arial][size=3]I always wanted the interface of Stardew Valley to be more beautiful and interesting, and I think this mod solves a part, This mod changes the UI according to the season, to give more immersiveness to the game.

Almost the entire mod was made with elements from Stardew Valley, for example, the vines were taken from the wizard's tower and improved by me, this with the aim of being as vanilla as possible.
Before I forget, [color=#ff0000]THE MOD SHOULD WORK WITH OTHER MODS THAT CHANGE THE INTERFACE[/color], that it looks good is another matter.
Quick explanation: my mod overlaps the other mods using patchmode, so you shouldn't have problems loading it with another mod that changes the color of the interface, in any case, ask if you still have questions!
[/size]
[size=3]The mod was improved by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/132025663]@Vlgor[/url][color=#00ff00]﻿﻿[/color][color=#ea9999], Thank you very much for improving it![/color]

All the designs for Earthy Recolor and Vibrant Pastoral were redrawn by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mangozey]Mangozey[/url]﻿! [color=#a64d79]Thank you for making it possible.[/color]

[size=6]NEW IN 3.0.0[/size]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]- 2 New portraits were added for each season, these will rotate with the old portraits to give a little more depth to the mod
- Two new versions have been added that resemble the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral[/url]﻿. Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mangozey]Mangozey[/url]﻿ for making this possible ❤️![/size][/color][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5IHKjX2.png[/img]
﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/rXPlfgK.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/oCue1sM.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/l1q6wo9.gif[/img]﻿﻿﻿
[/size][/font][color=#e06666][font=Arial][size=3]A [/size][size=5]❤[/size][size=3] for you if you have downloaded my mod.
Feel free to comment whatever you want, I will surely answer :3[/size][/font]
[/color][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/SWVYd8J.png[/img]﻿
